corporate transport teams, and employee shuttle services. Automate dispatching, track vehicles in

## Fixed Route & On-Demand Transportation Solutions

#### Transportation solutions at the speed of life.

Serve all corners of your community using our easy-to-manage software solution that puts you in
control of a flexible, convenient transit system.

## Fixed Route Services Solution

#### Monitor and manage your fixed route system and enhance your rider experience.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT FIXED ROUTE ][40]

## Microtransit & On-Demand Services

#### Provide on-demand service where and when your riders need it.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT ON-DEMAND ][41]

### Reinvent Your Transit Operations

For two decades we’ve provided bus transit software solutions to transit agencies, schools,
airports, hospitals, and other organizations. We specialize in fixed route and on demand access
solutions, and provide reporting, GTFS feed and rider- and driver-facing apps.

Reduce rider wait times, implement new routes, manage your system,  our Fixed Route and OnDemand
solutions optimize the performance of your transportation services. We provide the full spectrum of
transit hardware, software, and partner services to power your Fixed Route and OnDemand operations.

### Who We Serve

## About Asia Tech x Singapore

Asia Tech x Singapore (ATxSG) is Asia’s flagship technology event jointly organised by Infocomm
Media Development Authority of Singapore (IMDA) and Informa, and supported by the Singapore Tourism
Board. The event encompasses three core components: ATxSummit, ATxEnterprise, and the year-round
ATxInspire programme.

## ATxEnterprise

Organised by Informa at Singapore EXPO, ATxEnterprise is the commercial heart of ATxSG. It serves as
Asia’s central marketplace for broadcast technology, telecommunications infrastructure, satellite
communications, and enterprise solutions, bringing together the region’s tech ecosystem to showcase
innovations, build partnerships, and exchange insights that drive digital transformation.

From frontier technologies to next-generation infrastructure, ATxEnterprise connects innovators,
decision-makers, and disruptors shaping the future of Asia’s digital economy.

[Read More][37]

Hosted by IMDA at Capella Singapore, ATxSummit serves as the apex event of ATxSG, comprising two
distinct experiences: The Plenary and The Village.

The Plenary presents an invitation-only conference exploring critical themes including agentic and
embodied AI, enterprise adoption strategies, workforce adaptation, and practical governance models.

The Village curates exclusive government-to-government and government-to-business roundtables where
senior government officials, industry leaders and academia address digital challenges, alongside
symposiums, workshops, showcases, and more.

[Read More][38]

## ATxInspire

ATxInspire, a companion series to ATxSummit, hosts a year-round series of thought-provoking
discussions and presentations by industry leaders, government officials, and academics. These events
focus on cutting-edge advancements in technology, empowering the tech community to stay ahead of the
curve. Organised by IMDA, ATxInspire fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing within the tech
sector.

[Read More][39]

##### Central Analysis Bureau

# Clarity in Risk. Confidence in Decisions.

Proprietary rating and tracking system to assess risk, inform your decisions, and find clients that
fit your appetite.

## Stronger and More Profitable Operations

Access millions of safety records and powerful analytics from Central Analysis Bureau to help
insurance carriers, brokers, and fleet managers build stronger, more profitable operations.

### Underwriters

Write Accurate Policies
More Efficiently

[ See Our Solution ][26]

### Agent/Brokers

Uncover Risk Profiles
More Quickly

[ See Our Solution ][27]

### Motor Carrier Solutions

Discover New Ways to Lower Your Risk

[ See Our Solution ][28]

## The Fusable Difference

Central Analysis Bureau is part of the Fusable family of Risk and Asset intelligence data products,
alongside [**Price Digests**][29], which provides comprehensive vehicle valuations and VIN decoding
for commercial trucks and trailers.

With a focus on innovation and customer-centricity, Fusable fuses multiple datasets into new
abilities to understand your markets, sell more, and reduce risk.

[ Learn More ][30]

## Subscribe to Our Newsletter

We’re excited to provide you with impactful resources to support your success, like our new ***Risk
Index Report Newsletter***, bringing you quarterly expert insights into the motor carrier risk
industry.

# Lyft Fare Estimator

Pickup Location: Drop-off Location:

Planning your next Lyft ride just got easier. Our **Lyft calculator** takes the guesswork out of
your travel expenses and provides a real-time fare estimate.

## Get Your Estimate in 3 Easy Steps

### 1. Enter Pickup

Start typing your pickup address. The tool will help you find the exact spot.

### 2. Enter Drop-off

Next, enter your drop-off location to set your destination for the trip.

### 3. See Your Price!

Our calculator will instantly show you the estimated cost for your Lyft ride.

[A phone showing the Lyft app with a map and fare details.]

## What's in a Lyft Price?

Ever wonder why a ride costs what it does? The final price is a mix of a few key parts:
* **Distance:** The miles or kilometers of your trip.
* **Time:** The minutes your ride takes from start to finish.
* **Base Fare:** A flat fee for starting the ride.
* **Prime Time:** During busy hours, prices may be higher to encourage more drivers to get on the
  road.

## Comparing Your Ride Options

While Lyft is a great choice for ridesharing, it helps to compare all your options when planning a
trip. If you're also considering traditional taxi services, the [taxi cost calculator][6] can help
you estimate fares for any taxi ride in the world and make the best decision for your budget and
needs.

## Choose Your Ride

Lyft has different cars for different needs. Here are the most common ones you will see:

### Lyft

The standard, affordable ride for up to 4 people.

### Extra Comfort

Roomier rides with top rated drivers for a more relaxing trip.

### Lyft XL

An SUV or minivan that can seat up to 6 people.

### Lyft Black

Premium black car service for business or luxury travel.

## Example Fare Prices

To give you an idea of costs, here are example prices for a 5-mile, 10-minute trip in different
locations.

### Most Affordable Locations
* [Aberdeen, South Dakota][7] ($10.00)
* [Albany, Georgia][8] ($10.50)
* [Eureka, California][9] ($11.00)
* [Ardmore, Oklahoma][10] ($11.50)
* [Waterloo, Iowa][11] ($12.00)

### Higher-Priced Locations
* [New York City, New York][12] ($45.00)
* [San Francisco, California][13] ($42.50)
* [Los Angeles, California][14] ($40.00)
* [Chicago, Illinois][15] ($38.00)
* [Washington, D.C.][16] ($36.50)

## Have More Questions?

We've got you covered. Here are our simple guides to the most common questions:

  Getting in touch with Lyft can be tricky. We explain the best ways on our [Lyft Customer
  Service][27] page.
* **Is Lyft in my town?**
  Use our simple [Lyft Availability Checker][28] to see if you can get a ride from your address.
* **What are all the cities Lyft serves?**
  Lyft is in hundreds of places! You can see the full list on our [Lyft Cities][29] page.
* **How is Lyft's stock performing?**
  Curious about the company's financials? Check the latest charts on our [Lyft Stock Price][30]
  page.

We're not affiliated with Lyft®, but we strive to offer you the best Lyft guide. Be sure to estimate
your next Lyft trip.

## **Simplifying Online Booking of Cab, Auto and Bike**

Getting a cab should be an easy task, specially when there are so many cab aggregators operating in
the same city....

We bring you all the options in a single app to make sure you always get the best cab, at the best

## [][3]
## Are you a regular Cab user ?

Book your next cab at cheapest price

Save upto 50% on long distance & Airport rides

Find more ride hail options that you didn't know existed

Just one app to find the best ride across cab services

Reduce the app clutter in your mobile

## [][4]
## How does Cab Compare work ?

**Step ****1**

**Select your pickup & destination where you want to travel**

**Step 2**

**Link your accounts to see prices**

**Step ****3**

**Filter type of ride like Car/Auto/Bike/SUV and ****book your favorite ride from the list. **

## [][5]
## Are you a Cab Aggregator?

**Add immense value to your business **

Use our marketplace platform for passenger demand generation and outsourcing your technology stack,
so that you can focus on building your brand and manage business critical things like ground
operations, maintaining fleet quality and providing support to passengers & drivers. We Offer,

**T****ool for Quick Demand Generation**

For a ride hailing model to functionally work, it requires building a huge supply of drivers and
multiple marketing campaigns to bring vast number of users on the platform, but achieving this
simultaneously can be an expensive and mammoth task. Our platform solves the second leg of this
problem for you, it is already being used by thousands of cab users across India and your services
can be made immediately visible to all of them.

**Unrestricted Operations & Improved User Retention**

Takes out the dependency on creating a minimum driver supply before starting operations, our search
algorithm shows your drivers to passenger's ride request, only if they are nearby and available to
take that ride. Hence no need to keep operations concentrated within specific localities, no need to
schedule rides instead of on-demand service and no fear of providing bad experience to your users

**Lower Cost of Acquiring Customers**

Skip the long queue of impressions, clicks, installs and attritions, directly reach out to paying
cab users in no time

**Smooth City Launch - Expand ****your**** business pan India**

Our pan India presence makes it possible for you to launch your services in any city of your choice,
that too with limited number of drivers. For e.g. we have thousands of active users in New Delhi who
can quickly start using your services if you wish to launch in New Delhi (Yes !! even if you want to
start with just 1000 drivers).

**Savings on Tech Infrastructure Costs**

We take care of common costs like place APIs, search results, map load, tracking, server, payment
gateway etc. across aggregators, so that you are not alone to take the burden of these expenditures

Ready to skyrocket your Business ?

**T****ool for Quick Demand Generation**

For a ride hailing model to functionally work, it requires building a huge supply of drivers and
multiple marketing campaigns to bring vast number of users on the platform, but achieving this
simultaneously can be an expensive and mammoth task. Our platform solves the second leg of this
problem for you, it is already being used by thousands of cab users across India and your services
can be made immediately visible to all of them.

algorithm shows your drivers to passenger's ride request, only if they are nearby and available to
take that ride. Hence no need to keep operations concentrated within specific localities, no need to
schedule rides instead of on-demand service and no fear of providing bad experience to your users

**Lower Cost of Acquiring Customers**

Skip the long queue of impressions, clicks, installs and attritions, directly reach out to paying
cab users in no time

**Smooth City Launch - Expand ****your**** business pan India**

Our pan India presence makes it possible for you to launch your services in any city of your choice,
that too with limited number of drivers. For e.g. we have thousands of active users in New Delhi who
can quickly start using your services if you wish to launch in New Delhi (Yes !! even if you want to
start with just 1000 drivers).

We take care of common costs like place APIs, search results, map load, tracking, server, payment
gateway etc. across aggregators, so that you are not alone to take the burden of these expenditures

### What is a QR Code?

QR Code is a two-dimensional version of the barcode, typically made up of black and white pixel
patterns. Denso Wave, a Japanese subsidiary of the Toyota supplier Denso, developed them for marking
components in order to accelerate logistics processes for their automobile production. Now, it has
found its way into mobile marketing with the widespread adoption of smartphones. “QR” stands for
“Quick Response”, which refers to the instant access to the information hidden in the Code.

## About us

S&A Law Offices (“S&A”) is a full-service law firm comprising of experienced, well-recognized, and
accomplished professionals. S&A is assisting its clients in diverse practices areas.

With Registered Office at Gurugram and its other offices at New Delhi, Mumbai, along with associate
offices across India, S&A is fully equipped to provide legal services on a pan-India basis.

[Read more][37]

### Expertise

#### Litigation and ADR

Litigation and ADR Practice Group assists clients with strategic decision-making in litigation and
ADR matters.

[Learn more][38]

#### Commercial Transactions

S&A’s commercial transactions practice team assists clients in a broad range of commercial
transactions & arrangements.

[Learn more][39]

#### Corporate and Allied Laws

S&A handles domestic as well as international clients and renders services such as corporate
advisory, company formations and tax structuring

[Learn more][40]

#### Intellectual Property Rights

S&A Intellectual Property Practice Group assist clients in all types of registrations, enforcement,
commercialization, licensing/assignments, maintenance and evaluations of intellectual property
rights in India.

[Learn more][41]

#### Valuation

S&A’s Valuation services aim to help clients prevent compliance issues triggered by gaps in any
processes or by someone’s mal intention or due to loopholes in technologies implemented in
businesses.

[Learn more][42]

#### Indirect Tax, Customs & Trade

Every commercial transaction has taxation aspects, and businesses need to identify them to fulfil
their tax responsibilities.

[Learn more][43]

# Cab Fleet Management Software for Transport & Corporate Companies

VectraRide is an end-to-end fleet management platform built for cab operators, taxi companies,
corporate transport teams, and employee shuttle services. Automate dispatching, track vehicles in
real time, manage drivers, generate invoices, and stay 100% compliant – all from one dashboard.

[ Contact Sales ][20][ View Features ][21]

### Our comprehensive platform provides all the tools necessary to manage and grow your cab business
### efficiently.

Specialized App Suite

Access three dedicated applications each with its own secure login and tailored interface for
corporate, fleet, and school needs.

Auto-Allocation Engine

A rule-based system that synchronizes transport requests into optimized time-slots, eliminating the
need for manual dispatchers.

Compliance Shield

Proactive, automated tracking of document expiries (Insurance, Fitness, Permits) to prevent legal
fines and ensure 100% fleet legality.

Maintenance Pipeline

Direct mobile-to-web reporting that converts driver-logged road incidents into trackable maintenance
work orders instantly.

Billing & Invoicing

Automated fare calculations with strict version control—ensuring that current rate changes never
affect or corrupt your historical financial records.

Real-Time Driver & User Apps

A connected network of mobile apps for Drivers, Users, and Parents, providing live GPS tracking and
instant status updates.

software solution for operators of any size.

Corporate Transport Teams

Streamline employee pick-up and drop scheduling, manage dedicated corporate cabs, and generate
automated invoices for HR and finance teams. VectraRide is the trusted corporate cab management
software for enterprises.

Fleet & Transport Companies

Run a smarter transport business with an automated fleet management system that handles routing,
compliance, maintenance, and reporting -so you focus on growth, not paperwork.

School & Campus Transport

Give parents peace of mind with live GPS tracking and real-time notifications. Our vehicle fleet
management system keeps school routes safe, punctual, and fully documented.

* Cloud-based fleet management platform - accessible from any device, anywhere

manual dispatchers and reducing idle time across your fleet.

## About Asia Tech x Singapore

Asia Tech x Singapore (ATxSG) is Asia’s flagship technology event jointly organised by Infocomm
Media Development Authority of Singapore (IMDA) and Informa, and supported by the Singapore Tourism
Board. The event encompasses three core components: ATxSummit, ATxEnterprise, and the year-round
ATxInspire programme.

## ATxEnterprise

Organised by Informa at Singapore EXPO, ATxEnterprise is the commercial heart of ATxSG. It serves as
Asia’s central marketplace for broadcast technology, telecommunications infrastructure, satellite
communications, and enterprise solutions, bringing together the region’s tech ecosystem to showcase
innovations, build partnerships, and exchange insights that drive digital transformation.

From frontier technologies to next-generation infrastructure, ATxEnterprise connects innovators,
decision-makers, and disruptors shaping the future of Asia’s digital economy.

[Read More][37]

## ATxSummit

Hosted by IMDA at Capella Singapore, ATxSummit serves as the apex event of ATxSG, comprising two
distinct experiences: The Plenary and The Village.

The Plenary presents an invitation-only conference exploring critical themes including agentic and
embodied AI, enterprise adoption strategies, workforce adaptation, and practical governance models.

The Village curates exclusive government-to-government and government-to-business roundtables where
senior government officials, industry leaders and academia address digital challenges, alongside
symposiums, workshops, showcases, and more.

[Read More][38]

## ATxInspire

ATxInspire, a companion series to ATxSummit, hosts a year-round series of thought-provoking
discussions and presentations by industry leaders, government officials, and academics. These events
focus on cutting-edge advancements in technology, empowering the tech community to stay ahead of the
curve. Organised by IMDA, ATxInspire fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing within the tech
sector.

[Read More][39]

## About Asia Tech x Singapore

Asia Tech x Singapore (ATxSG) is Asia’s flagship technology event jointly organised by Infocomm
Media Development Authority of Singapore (IMDA) and Informa, and supported by the Singapore Tourism
Board. The event encompasses three core components: ATxSummit, ATxEnterprise, and the year-round
ATxInspire programme.

## ATxEnterprise

Organised by Informa at Singapore EXPO, ATxEnterprise is the commercial heart of ATxSG. It serves as
Asia’s central marketplace for broadcast technology, telecommunications infrastructure, satellite
communications, and enterprise solutions, bringing together the region’s tech ecosystem to showcase
innovations, build partnerships, and exchange insights that drive digital transformation.

From frontier technologies to next-generation infrastructure, ATxEnterprise connects innovators,
decision-makers, and disruptors shaping the future of Asia’s digital economy.

[Read More][37]

## ATxSummit

Hosted by IMDA at Capella Singapore, ATxSummit serves as the apex event of ATxSG, comprising two
distinct experiences: The Plenary and The Village.

The Plenary presents an invitation-only conference exploring critical themes including agentic and
embodied AI, enterprise adoption strategies, workforce adaptation, and practical governance models.

The Village curates exclusive government-to-government and government-to-business roundtables where
senior government officials, industry leaders and academia address digital challenges, alongside
symposiums, workshops, showcases, and more.

[Read More][38]

## ATxInspire

ATxInspire, a companion series to ATxSummit, hosts a year-round series of thought-provoking
discussions and presentations by industry leaders, government officials, and academics. These events
focus on cutting-edge advancements in technology, empowering the tech community to stay ahead of the
curve. Organised by IMDA, ATxInspire fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing within the tech
sector.

[Read More][39]

**Add immense value to your business **

so that you can focus on building your brand and manage business critical things like ground

**T****ool for Quick Demand Generation**

For a ride hailing model to functionally work, it requires building a huge supply of drivers and
multiple marketing campaigns to bring vast number of users on the platform, but achieving this
simultaneously can be an expensive and mammoth task. Our platform solves the second leg of this
problem for you, it is already being used by thousands of cab users across India and your services

algorithm shows your drivers to passenger's ride request, only if they are nearby and available to

schedule rides instead of on-demand service and no fear of providing bad experience to your users

Skip the long queue of impressions, clicks, installs and attritions, directly reach out to paying

can quickly start using your services if you wish to launch in New Delhi (Yes !! even if you want to
start with just 1000 drivers).

**Savings on Tech Infrastructure Costs**

We take care of common costs like place APIs, search results, map load, tracking, server, payment
gateway etc. across aggregators, so that you are not alone to take the burden of these expenditures

### What is a QR Code?

QR Code is a two-dimensional version of the barcode, typically made up of black and white pixel
patterns. Denso Wave, a Japanese subsidiary of the Toyota supplier Denso, developed them for marking
components in order to accelerate logistics processes for their automobile production. Now, it has
found its way into mobile marketing with the widespread adoption of smartphones. “QR” stands for
“Quick Response”, which refers to the instant access to the information hidden in the Code.

## About us

S&A Law Offices (“S&A”) is a full-service law firm comprising of experienced, well-recognized, and
accomplished professionals. S&A is assisting its clients in diverse practices areas.

With Registered Office at Gurugram and its other offices at New Delhi, Mumbai, along with associate
offices across India, S&A is fully equipped to provide legal services on a pan-India basis.

[Read more][37]

### Expertise

#### Litigation and ADR

Litigation and ADR Practice Group assists clients with strategic decision-making in litigation and
ADR matters.

[Learn more][38]

#### Commercial Transactions

S&A’s commercial transactions practice team assists clients in a broad range of commercial
transactions & arrangements.

[Learn more][39]

#### Corporate and Allied Laws

S&A handles domestic as well as international clients and renders services such as corporate
advisory, company formations and tax structuring

[Learn more][40]

#### Intellectual Property Rights

S&A Intellectual Property Practice Group assist clients in all types of registrations, enforcement,
commercialization, licensing/assignments, maintenance and evaluations of intellectual property
rights in India.

[Learn more][41]

#### Valuation

S&A’s Valuation services aim to help clients prevent compliance issues triggered by gaps in any
processes or by someone’s mal intention or due to loopholes in technologies implemented in
businesses.

[Learn more][42]

#### Indirect Tax, Customs & Trade

Every commercial transaction has taxation aspects, and businesses need to identify them to fulfil
their tax responsibilities.

[Learn more][43]

stands for technologies that enables future mobility. Building on 125 years of continuous
innovation, we design all our solutions for series production, global scalability and long‑term
reliability. This legacy drives us today as strongly as it has throughout our history.
